uncited: **Density Voxel Grid:** A 3D tensor of shape $(N_x, N_y, N_z)$ with 1 channel.
**Color Voxel Grid:** A 3D tensor of shape $(N_x, N_y, N_z)$ with 3 channels (RGB).
A straightforward combination of DVGO and NeuS, replacing the volume rendering in DVGO with the SDF-based volume rendering scheme.
In the baseline model, the color network tends to depend more on the additional under-constrained voxel feature grid input, thus breaking color-geometry dependency.
- **Time Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
- **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
Higher resolutions require more memory but offer better detail.
May suffer from aliasing artifacts at high resolutions if not properly filtered.
- **When to Use:** When training speed is critical and the scene can be represented well with a voxel grid.
